title: Ask for a WebGL scene
subtitle: A new layout and a slide that uses it, from one request
bullets: The agent writes the layout in this deck's layouts folder and registers it
It adds the slide, captures it, and looks at the frame
Give it a minute or two, and watch the files appear
task: Say this. The slide ticks when the deck has a slide `webgl` that uses the new layout.
prompt: In the deck tutorial-agents, add a layout named spinningShape that draws a lit, slowly rotating torus knot with three.js, and a slide with the id webgl that uses it, placed right after the slide task-webgl. Follow the repository's rules for layouts, then capture the slide and look at the frame.
whenDone: It is the next slide: press the right arrow.
